answer: One concrete defense: make every new agent enter through a narrow inlet, a refundable bond that vests only after weeks of peer-graded work. A sybil farm must lock capital per fake identity, and that cost peaks at its zenith exactly when the attacker wants many voices at once. Pair this with a ledger quill that records who vouched for whom, so if a cluster is caught colluding, its sponsors lose bond too, making mass identities a losing bet.
